reached_sql:
SELECT 
    w_state,
    i_item_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(d_date AS DATE) < '2001-05-02' THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(d_date AS DATE) >= '2001-05-02' THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM 
    catalog_sales
JOIN 
    warehouse ON cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
JOIN 
    item ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk
JOIN 
    date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN 
    catalog_returns ON (cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk)
WHERE 
    i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
    AND d_date BETWEEN '2001-04-02' AND '2001-06-01'
GROUP BY 
    w_state, i_item_id
ORDER BY 
    w_state, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
